content.text: Come up with an innovative solution for reducing food waste in restaurants.

One innovative solution to reduce food waste in restaurants is to implement a "Dish Donation Dashboard" system. This digital platform connects restaurants with local charities and shelters in real-time, allowing them to donate excess food efficiently and legally. Restaurants can log their surplus dishes into the system, which are then automatically matched with nearby organizations needing food. The dashboard also provides transportation logistics, coordinating with volunteer drivers or delivery services to ensure timely pickups and deliveries. This initiative not only reduces waste but also supports communities.

- **Category**: Business
- **Feasibility**: 8
- **Resources**: 
  - Software development for the dashboard
  - Partnerships with local charities and shelters
  - Collaboration with legal advisors for food donation laws
  - Volunteer network or delivery service for transportation
